_comment: cloud-ci-supply-chain-audit gate policy (owned RustSec advisory scan; replaces the reverted #974 shell cargo-audit/deny). R1 pack-shaped DATA: lockfile_corpus is the authoritative, reviewed set of workspace-owned lockfiles, pairing each repo-relative Cargo.toml workspace root with its sibling Cargo.lock. The collector independently projects workspace-owned locks from scm_facts_path#tracked_paths: a tracked Cargo.lock is owned exactly when its tracked sibling Cargo.toml declares [workspace]. That exact projection must equal lockfile_corpus, so a newly tracked workspace lock fails until declared while orphan and member-local locks cannot expand the scan. The collector then reads only declared locks and the vendored content-addressed RustSec mirror; it never recursively walks mutable filesystem state. Normalized relative paths, sibling ownership, regular-file type, no-symlink containment, strict non-empty [[package]] rows, and the min_lockfiles shrink floor are validated fail-closed. The legacy single lockfile_path shape remains engine-compatible for adopters. Security advisories block as SCA-VULN; unmaintained advisories block as SCA-UNMAINTAINED (gated by unmaintained_policy=all). Mirror content_hash/count/min_advisories fail closed. No shell, network, or clock.

ignore.reason: async-std is unmaintained; no maintained drop-in is wired yet. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.
ignore.pull_chain: transitive dependency in the workspace graph (async-std 1.13.2 in Cargo.lock)

ignore.reason: paste is unmaintained; it is a widely-used proc-macro shim with no maintained drop-in replacement. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.
proc-macro-error2 is unmaintained; pulled transitively by derive macros with no maintained drop-in yet. Time-boxed grandfather moved from the reverted #974 deny.toml.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking: the exact workspace-owned lock projection from the materialized tracked-tree facts must equal lockfile_corpus, then every declared lock is matched against the advisory mirror. A fifth workspace lock or any affected security advisory/unmaintained crate in the root, kernel, cloud-kernel, or detached host-test lockfile blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; repo-specific workspace/lockfile pairs, scm_facts_path, min_lockfiles, mirror_dir, and ignores are DATA here. Legacy adopters using one lockfile_path remain supported without multi-workspace projection.
product_contract.hermetic: Pure Rust predicate: serde_json + toml + semver only (no rustsec/git2/libgit2, shell, network, clock, or recursive filesystem discovery). The separately materialized scm-facts tracked-path universe supplies totality; only tracked sibling manifests are parsed to identify explicit [workspace] owners. Declared paths are normalized repo-relative sibling pairs; symlinks, missing files, type errors, malformed manifests, zero-package locks, malformed package rows, projection mismatch, and policy underflow fail closed. The collected JSON schema remains locked/name/version + advisories + manifest.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: Upgrade the affected crate to a patched version, or — for an unmaintained dep with no maintained drop-in — add a time-boxed ignore[] entry with reason/pull_chain/remove_by.
